scope: Proposition 2.2 of the manuscript “Uniform effective log Iitaka fibrations for fourfolds” (preprints/Uniform-effective-log-Iitaka-fibrations-for-fourfolds-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8036215575dbf619), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X, ∆) be a projective lc rational pair of dimension four over C, with D = KX + ∆ Q-Cartier and κ(X, D) ≥ 0. There is a projective Q-factorial dlt pair (X′, ∆′) with semiample adjoint D′ = KX′ + ∆′ such that, under the identification of rational function fields and compatible canonical divisors, H0 X, OX(⌊mD⌋)  = H0 X′ , OX′ (⌊mD′ ⌋)  (m ≥ 1). (2.1) The coefficients of ∆′ belong to those of ∆ together with 1. The map is obtained by a crepant dlt modification followed by adjoint-negative birational steps. For a Q-factorial klt input the latter steps can be taken directly, with klt outputs. The semiample contraction f : X′ → Z has dim Z = κ(X, D) and D′ ∼Q f ∗ A for an ample rational Cartier divisor A on the normal projective variety Z.
